note: The stylist asked *e os cedros do Líbano o Senhor quebrará*, to avoid ending on the proparoxytone; refused as an inversion that breaks the parallel with the first colon. His order is the option.
*corças*, held against the Latinist (minor, then major at the gate): the Latin is masculine. *cervos* is heard as *servos* (the 17:34 ruling). The blind reader did not know *corças*.
